## Summary of the last run

The page is a careful, self-contained treatment of the structure theorem for finite abelian groups. The proofs of primary decomposition, the maximal-order direct-summand lemma, the cyclic decomposition, uniqueness via $p^{k}G/p^{k+1}G$, the structure theorem, invariant factors, and the duality theorem all check out, and the cited labels match their uses. The supplements and remarks were examined individually: the finite-generation supplement, the duality remarks, the Pontryagin duality supplement, and the Galois-connection remark are all accurate. The only point I scrutinized was the hypcheck claim about $\Hom(\Q/\Z,\Q/\Z)$ being uncountable and hence not isomorphic to $\Z$; this is in fact correct (the group is the profinite completion $\hat{\Z}$, which is uncountable), so no genuine error was found. No new issues are reported.
